data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin that creates a native platform view to scan documents.
data.what_it_does: It provides a widget that integrates native platform document scanning functionality directly into Flutter applications. The package captures documents and returns the scanned result via callback.
use_when: You need a native document scanning widget inside an Android or iOS Flutter app.
You want to capture scanned documents and retrieve them as files or image paths.
avoid_when: You need heavy customization of the document scanner options, as customization currently does not work.
You need scanning capabilities on web or desktop platforms.
strengths: Simplifies adding document scanning capabilities via native platform views.
Returns structured image objects with file conversion helpers.
weaknesses: Document scanner customization options are currently not working.
Only supports Android and iOS platforms.
data.setup_notes: Requires handling camera permissions. For iOS, add io.flutter.embedded_views_preview and NSCameraUsageDescription keys to Info.plist. For Android, ensure minSdkVersion is at least 19.
